title: qnx-portcheck
card_text:
A host-side Linux to QNX 8.0 portability checker
Runs on the development host; never on a QNX target
narration: A host-side portability review for Linux projects targeting QNX 8.0.

title: Scan the Linux daemon
narration: We scan the epoll and inotify Linux daemon from the repository.
Findings are suggestions grounded in QNX 8.0 documentation; review them in project context.

title: Machine-readable reports
narration: The same scan can emit JSON for tools and SARIF for code review.
The bundled CI action in action/action.yml can upload SARIF to code scanning when permissions allow.

title: Generate draft build files
narration: Scaffolding previews and writes draft build files in a temporary project copy.
Each file carries a provenance header citing the exact qnx-ports build-files commit it follows.
Generated files still need review and were not built with an SDP.

title: Check mkifs buildfiles
narration: The clean example passes the host-side buildfile check.
The intentionally bad fixture reports an error and exits with status one.
Each rule links to the QNX 8.0 mkifs documentation.
